verdict.summary: The diff is limited to CI cache-key documentation and attribution plus the intended consolidation of the coverage-measure matrix onto a single rust-cache shared-key. The explanation accurately distinguishes dependency artifacts from workspace artifacts, acknowledges the partial-restore/save-race tradeoff across non-identical shards, preserves main-only cache saving, and makes clear that shard selection remains controlled independently by COVERAGE_SHARD. No correctness, soundness, security, or test-validity defect is evident in the scoped change.
